summary: Iteration 2 testing of getmano: 32/32 iteration-1 regression tests PASS; 14/14 new iteration-2 tests PASS after cleaning a stale duplicate seed doc. All NEW backend endpoints work (upload, files, gallery add/remove, plan change, messaging full flow client<->provider with unread tracking, users/me update). Frontend: landing, login (Google + Apple-disabled + Facebook-disabled), register, demo provider login, 4-tab provider dashboard, /messages, /profile, public eCard with share modal (WhatsApp/Facebook/SMS/Email/Copy) and Mensaje button all render & work. CRITICAL FINDINGS: (a) Two provider_profiles docs with same slug existed for demo provider (no unique index on slug, seed-data drift caused stale duplicate with mismatched user_id — broke messaging, /providers/me, and self-message guard). I deleted the stale doc to unblock testing — but main agent must add a unique index on provider_profiles.slug and/or fix the seed to be re-entrant. (b) ProviderProfileIn pydantic model does NOT declare the new fields is_home_based, latitude, longitude, additional_categories — they are silently dropped on POST/PUT (Pydantic strips unknowns). Even though the UI sends them, they never persist. (c) The agent_to_agent context note says gallery is part of the model but ProviderProfileIn doesn't have it either — only the $push gallery endpoint works.

critical.issue: ProviderProfileIn does NOT declare is_home_based, latitude, longitude, additional_categories, gallery. Pydantic silently drops these on input — UI sends them, backend persists nothing. Need to add fields to ProviderProfileIn (and to ProviderProfile model).

No unique index on `slug`. Demo provider had TWO profile docs with the same slug 'maria-cleaning-services-sallisaw-ok' (user_id mismatch with demo.provider user). This breaks GET /providers/me, messaging conversation routing (provider_user_id from stale doc), and self-message guard. RCA: previous test runs or restarts re-inserted; seed only checks user existence not profile existence atomically. Mitigation: add unique index on slug; make seed idempotent on provider_profiles (find by slug, not just by user).

minor.issue: Accepts arbitrary URL strings (no validation it points to /api/files/... or is http(s)). Could be abused with javascript: URLs in caption rendering — confirm frontend escapes.
subject defaults to 'Solicitud' only on first message; reply does not allow updating subject. Acceptable but worth noting.
Returns 404 only when the DB record is missing; if storage returns 403/500 we surface 502. No CDN caching headers (Cache-Control) — images are reproxied each request.

ui_bugs.issue: Form fields lack stable name/data-testid attributes (input[name=name], input[name=email] not present). Hard to target in automation. Add data-testid='register-name-input', 'register-email-input', 'register-password-input', 'register-submit-button', 'register-role-provider', 'register-role-client'.
Email/password inputs also missing data-testid for automation (only [data-testid=login-google-button|login-apple-button|login-facebook-button] exist).
Gallery section not rendered on demo eCard because demo seed has no gallery items. After provider uploads, verify it appears. Consider seeding 2-3 gallery items on demo for showcase.

integration_issues.issue: Could not fully exercise the wizard programmatically due to missing data-testid on /register form. Visually the Register page is correct (Google active, Apple/FB disabled with 'próximamente'). Recommend main agent self-test the 6-step wizard end-to-end after adding data-testid attributes.
Nominatim is rate-limited public service; flaky for automated tests. Did not test the populate-city/state/zip behavior automatically. Recommend manual verification.

issues: Looks clean. 4 tabs visible (Perfil/Galería/Mensajes/Suscripción). KPIs cards readable. Local físico / Desde casa toggle clear. ‘Categorías adicionales’ chip group works visually. Logo+Cover upload zones present.
GET /api/auth/me returns 401 (expected) but is logged as console error on landing and login pages. Iteration-1 carryover. Catch silently in AuthContext.

action_items: Add is_home_based, latitude, longitude, additional_categories, gallery fields to ProviderProfileIn so POST/PUT actually persist them (currently silently dropped)
Add unique index on db.provider_profiles.slug (and likely on user_id) to prevent duplicate-profile drift
Make seed() idempotent on provider_profiles (find by slug, not just by user existence)
Add data-testid attributes to /register form inputs (name/email/password/role-provider/role-client/submit) and to /login email/password inputs
Seed demo provider with 2-3 gallery items so the eCard gallery section renders for visitors
Silently swallow 401 from /api/auth/me on initial unauthenticated page load to clean console
Consider rate-limiting POST /api/providers/{id}/contact-click (still unauthenticated from iteration 1)
Validate GalleryItemIn.url to be http(s):// or /api/files/ paths (avoid XSS/javascript: URLs)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to ~850 lines (iteration 1: ~580). Split into modules (auth, providers, messaging, storage, admin, models, db) before it grows further.
ProviderProfileIn missing the new fields — biggest functional gap; UI sends, backend drops.
init_storage uses module-level global `_storage_key` — fine for single worker but not safe under multi-process supervisor. Wrap in lock or move to lazy per-request init with cache invalidation.
put_object/get_object reinit logic on 403 retries only once and uses `global _storage_key` mutation — works but better to encapsulate in a small client class.
send_message creates conversation_id but doesn't validate that body is non-empty (allows empty messages). Add `min_length=1` on MessageIn.body.
list_messages marks read unconditionally for the viewing side — good. But no pagination (limit 500). Add cursor.
POST /api/providers/me/gallery does not enforce a per-provider gallery cap (free plan should be limited to e.g. 3 photos per plans definition). Business rule not enforced server-side.
Plan change is mock (acknowledged) but no audit log written for plan changes. Consider audit_logs entry.
PUT /api/users/me allows arbitrary `picture` URL — same XSS/javascript: URL risk as gallery. Validate.
JWT_SECRET still falls back to 'getmano-dev-secret-change-me' default if env missing — should fail-fast in production.

rca_of_issue: DUPLICATE PROVIDER PROFILE: db.provider_profiles had two docs with slug='maria-cleaning-services-sallisaw-ok'. Doc A had user_id=user_cc2bae084f50 (stale, no matching user). Doc B had user_id=user_dd013c7efcff (current demo.provider user). Cause: seed() checks `if not await db.users.find_one(...)` then inserts BOTH a user and a provider_profile inside that block; if users collection is wiped/reset but provider_profiles isn't, the next seed re-inserts a NEW user (new uuid) and a NEW provider_profile (also new uuid) while the old provider_profile remains, producing two profiles for one slug. get_provider_by_slug uses find_one which returned the stale Doc A first, so messaging set provider_user_id=user_cc2bae... and the actual demo.provider user (user_dd013c7...) couldn't see their own conversations. Mitigation applied: deleted stale Doc A. Permanent fix: add unique index `provider_profiles.slug` and make seed idempotent on provider_profiles by slug, not by user.
